credits: Original pixel art for Verdant Reach, hand-pixelled in tools/art/crystal/skunk_cabbage.py. Drawn under the Crystal rule (docs/CREATURES.md); no sprite from any other game was copied, traced or imported.
notes: Crystal rule. LOOMING: the mottled maroon hood low and forward among big, bright, net-veined leaves that tower behind it, the lead leaf flung out low toward the foe. Gesture: steam curls up off the hood into the open air, swirls and thins away. Sport: a yellow-green spathe (the natural colour range of wild spathes; no named form exists).
